title: 01.01 - EU Login account requirement for EUSurvey participants
intent: Explain whether participants who already have an EU Login account need a separate EUSurvey registration.

applies_to.eusurvey_area: Logging in and creating an account

short_answer: No. An EU Login account is enough to access EUSurvey. You do not need to register separately for EUSurvey if you already have an EU Login account.
procedure: Sign in using your EU Login account.
important_conditions: This article applies to participants/respondents accessing EUSurvey.
This article does not explain how to create an EU Login account from scratch.
